text_block_list.text:
One day, Daiwa Scarlet was on a picnic
with her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah, what is this suspension bridge~!?
Are we seriously crossing this thiiing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, what!? This is no joke!
There are huge gaps between the floorboards!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(It's terrifying... But if even I chicken out,
there'll be no one to lend a hand... In that case!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is nothing!
Come on everyone, grab onto my hand.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... That's all of us
across safely now.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was so scary~.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Right...?
Honestly, I barely felt like I was alive...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it~. You weren't
scared at all, Scarlet-chan, were you?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Totally. As expected of an honor student!
It's not something the rest of us could pull off.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head to the next spot.
Wonder what kind of spine-chilling thrills are waiting for us next♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
I was actually really... Guys, wait up!
(Whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What is this...?
This makes it seem like I'm the only one...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like I'm just some boring buzzkill who can't read the room,
isn't that rightーー!!

In the back courtyard of Tracen Academy.
The secret spot where anyone comes to shout their true feelings――
Daiwa Scarlet was screaming at the top of her lungs.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was actually reeeeaaally
scared too! It's just, I always wanted to be
the most reliable person no matter what happens...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanted to pour cold water on the picnic!
Idiots, idiots, stupid bakaーー!

From her string of shouts,
I managed to grasp the general situation...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! In that case, I'll become number one in having fun together
and having the best scared reactions too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could this be going too far?
If I do that, I feel like I won't even be
myself anymore... Hmph, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek, who's there?!
Don't tell me you heard all of that?!

Since I had ended up eavesdropping, as a Trainer,
I decided to offer a bit of advice.
choice_data_list: Researching reactions sounds great to me.
You're fine just the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Researching reactions?! Ugggh,
so you really did hear everything, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, you've got a point!
I'll head back to my room right now, watch some UmaTube, and study up...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
So get this—the other day during training,
something totally wild happened!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really? That must've been shocking!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Now's my chance! This is it.
Time to show the fruits of my reaction study...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat-a-what?! For real-real, are you for real?!
Holy haisai surprise, my tail's blasting off to the moon!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
S-Scarlet-chan?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, how was that?
Pretty hype, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Hype? More like... how should I put it...
Well...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
...You're really good at imitating TV comedians.
It was so high quality, I'm honestly kinda impressed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?! Impressed?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Just copying variety show comics
isn't the answer. This is tough.
But still...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! Just you watch!
I'm gonna have the best reactions and become
the absolute most fun horse girl ever!

Her fighting spirit ablaze, Daiwa Scarlet vowed
to level up her fun-loving charm even further.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just the way I am...? Yeah, you're right.
I should just stick to my own pace.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I've come to my senses!

Daiwa Scarlet seemed to have cleared her doubts.
Then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, did you hear, Scarlet?!
Apparently, there's gonna be a pop quiz next period!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A pop quiz...? For real?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, panicking will only wear me out.
I might as well take it in stride and let my real skills do the talking.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, as expected of you...
You're always so composed...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Scarlet. Good timing.
I gotta talk to ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I grabbed one of your scarves from the room to polish my leather jacket. Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: HAAAH?! What were you thinking?! Unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What the heck did you do to my scarf?!
Next time, I'm using your jacket to polish my scarf!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Hey, you know Scarlet... With us, she's always so cool and collected, but...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... around people she's close to, her comebacks are razor-sharp. She might actually be pretty hilarious.

An honor student unshakeable in every situation.
Yet, around close friends, Daiwa Scarlet let loose without holding back.
